kairos physical therapy pllc.name: Bank account opening
kairos physical therapy pllc.brief:
Run the four assessments attached to this assessment workflow. Make sure to keep the tone of the assessment in the mindset of a financial services compliance analyst that works at a bank like Mercury who is onboarding businesses to their bank. 

Make sure the prose is very concise and do not be overtly verbose. Only share what is relevant to the decision.

Write no recommendation prose at all. Do not summarise the assessments or repeat what they established; the reader has just read them. The recommendation section is the follow-ups and nothing else.

Each follow-up is one thing to do before the account opens, with only the facts that justify it behind it. Two lines, at most three: the instruction, then why. If nobody could act on it tomorrow, leave it out — a connected business that is plainly a neighbour is a fact for the assessment, not a step. Steps come from what the record leaves open and from what a registry does not publish: a missing good-standing sub-status is an RFI, not a shrug.�skill-kyb-identification:Is this a real, distinct, active entity, and is it the one on the application?

Always:
- Verify the submitted business name matches a state filing
- Verify the submitted address matches a state filing
- Identify Secretary of State filings (domestic and foreign)
- Identify Certificate of Good Standing or Secretary of State filings sub status is in good standing
- Identify unsubmitted entity classification type
- Identify unsubmitted industry classification 
- Identify unsubmitted web presence and third-party profiles
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers 
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

If submitted:
- Verify that the TIN belongs to a name associated with the business entity. If a TIN is not submitted do not elevate
- Verify DBA names, this is not a requirement, if the DBA is not submitted you literally dont have to mention it
- Verify entity classification type for the business entity
- Verify third-party profiles for the business entity
- Verify website presence for the business entity
- Verify email for the business entity
- Verify phone for the business entity�skill-kyb-3:Does the business, any UBO, or any signer trigger a sanctions or enforcement obligation?

Always:
- Flag hits for submitted business name Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted business name Adverse Media hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people PEP hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Adverse Media hits�skill-kyb-activity:Is the industry eligible under policy, and is the business licensed where it operates?

Always:
- Identify whether the industry is a high-risk or prohibited industry
- Identify whether there is evidence of other industry activity not detected that point to high-risk or prohibited industries
- Identify presence and status of licenses required of the industry + jurisdiction. 
- Identify license link to officer / owner / person or business entity.�skill-1789767328449:Who ultimately owns this, who is authorized to sign, and does the attestation hold up?

Always:
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

When submitted:
- Verify business entities listed as owners / officers
- Verify people listed as owners / officers
- Verify registered agents listed as owners / officers�skill-financial-standing:Does the business carry debts, judgments or insolvency that bear on the account?

Always:
- Identify UCC and tax liens on the business, open and closed, with the secured party and what is secured
- Identify litigation naming the business, which side it is on, and any money judgment
- Identify bankruptcy filings by the business
- Read each against the business's age and line of work: equipment finance and an SBA loan are ordinary for a bakery; a state tax lien or an all-assets blanket filing is not

When submitted:
- Identify liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the submitted people

report.headline: Onboard subject to a beneficial ownership certification evidencing each member's licence, KYC on Joshua Gee with the adverse media item cleared, and a Certificate of Good Standing.

body.text: KAIROS PHYSICAL THERAPY PLLC holds one active domestic New York filing (file 6511786, registered 13 June 2022) under the submitted name, and no other state filings. The IRS holds a record for the submitted TIN and legal name combination.
The entity is a PLLC, a licensed professional practice organised as an LLC: its line of work is licensed activity and its membership is restricted to licensed professionals.
The website presents the practice as Kairos Physio rather than its legal name. No DBA filing is on the record for that name.

gaps.point: Whether the PLLC is in good standing: New York publishes an active status but no good-standing sub-status.

body.text: The watchlist screen returned no hits across the 14 lists searched, including OFAC SDN. The PEP screen returned no hits on Joshua Gee or his relatives and close associates.

The adverse media screen returned one negative item matched to Joshua Gee's name: a Herald Dispatch report of Lawrence County grand jury indictments, tagged narcotics and weapons. Nothing on the record ties the article to the submitted Joshua Gee beyond the name, and no item is matched to the business.

gaps.point: Whether the indictments article concerns the submitted Joshua Gee or a namesake.
gaps.wouldAnswer: A reviewer disposition of the article against Joshua Gee's KYC identifiers (date of birth, residential address).

gaps.point: Criminal history on Joshua Gee.
gaps.noAction: Not ordered and not a standard requirement for a deposit account; the watchlist and PEP screens are clear and the adverse media item is dispositioned separately.

body.text: The practice classifies as an office of physical therapists (NAICS 621340), outside high-risk and prohibited categories. The online third-party profiles, including a Google listing categorised as a physical therapy clinic, describe the same line of work.

The submitted office address, 801 Madison Ave Fl 3, New York, matches the filing, is a deliverable commercial property and appears on the website; the business is active in that state. The filing also lists a residential apartment in Bayside and an undeliverable address in Little Neck.
The submitted website is online, belongs to the business with high confidence and shows the submitted email and phone. It does not name Joshua Gee.

gaps.point: Whether the practice's physical therapists, including its members, hold current New York licences.
gaps.wouldAnswer: A New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions licence lookup for each member and practising therapist.

body.text: Joshua Gee, the only person submitted, is not matched to the state filing, which names only the PLLC itself for service of process; a New York LLC filing publishes no members or managers.

As a PLLC, membership is restricted by statute to individuals licensed in the profession, so the beneficial ownership certification has to evidence each member's licence as well as identity and percentage. A policy keyed on entity type reads this as a plain LLC and would not ask for it.

Two connections were found. KAIROS 801 LLC shares two filing addresses, the Bayside residence and 801 Madison Ave. J.L.W. INVESTORS, LTD. shares only 801 Madison Ave, a commercial address used by 21 businesses.

gaps.point: Who the PLLC's members are, their percentages, and Joshua Gee's role.
Identity verification of Joshua Gee.
Who is behind KAIROS 801 LLC and whether it shares ownership with the practice.

body.text: The business has no UCC or tax liens, no bankruptcy filings and no related litigation on record, consistent with a practice formed in 2022.

gaps.point: Liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming Joshua Gee.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a deposit account where the business-level record is clear.

followUps.text:
Collect a beneficial ownership certification naming each member, their percentage and New York physical therapy licence number, and confirming Joshua Gee's role.
The filing names no members, Joshua Gee is not matched to it, and a PLLC's members must be licensed.

Run KYC on Joshua Gee.
He is the only person submitted and no identity verification is held.

Clear the adverse media item against Joshua Gee's KYC identifiers.
One negative article on grand jury indictments is matched to his name only.

Verify each member's licence on the New York Office of the Professions lookup.
No check on the record covers professional licensing, which the PLLC form requires.

Submit an RFI for a Certificate of Good Standing.
New York publishes an active status but no good-standing sub-status.

Establish who is behind KAIROS 801 LLC.
It shares two filing addresses with the practice, including the Bayside residence; a common owner is plausible but not on the record.

kairos 801 llc.name: Bank account opening
kairos 801 llc.brief:
Run the four assessments attached to this assessment workflow. Make sure to keep the tone of the assessment in the mindset of a financial services compliance analyst that works at a bank like Mercury who is onboarding businesses to their bank. 

Make sure the prose is very concise and do not be overtly verbose. Only share what is relevant to the decision.

Write no recommendation prose at all. Do not summarise the assessments or repeat what they established; the reader has just read them. The recommendation section is the follow-ups and nothing else.

Each follow-up is one thing to do before the account opens, with only the facts that justify it behind it. Two lines, at most three: the instruction, then why. If nobody could act on it tomorrow, leave it out — a connected business that is plainly a neighbour is a fact for the assessment, not a step. Steps come from what the record leaves open and from what a registry does not publish: a missing good-standing sub-status is an RFI, not a shrug.�skill-kyb-identification:Is this a real, distinct, active entity, and is it the one on the application?

Always:
- Verify the submitted business name matches a state filing
- Verify the submitted address matches a state filing
- Identify Secretary of State filings (domestic and foreign)
- Identify Certificate of Good Standing or Secretary of State filings sub status is in good standing
- Identify unsubmitted entity classification type
- Identify unsubmitted industry classification 
- Identify unsubmitted web presence and third-party profiles
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers 
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

If submitted:
- Verify that the TIN belongs to a name associated with the business entity. If a TIN is not submitted do not elevate
- Verify DBA names, this is not a requirement, if the DBA is not submitted you literally dont have to mention it
- Verify entity classification type for the business entity
- Verify third-party profiles for the business entity
- Verify website presence for the business entity
- Verify email for the business entity
- Verify phone for the business entity�skill-kyb-3:Does the business, any UBO, or any signer trigger a sanctions or enforcement obligation?

Always:
- Flag hits for submitted business name Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted business name Adverse Media hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people PEP hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Adverse Media hits�skill-kyb-activity:Is the industry eligible under policy, and is the business licensed where it operates?

Always:
- Identify whether the industry is a high-risk or prohibited industry
- Identify whether there is evidence of other industry activity not detected that point to high-risk or prohibited industries
- Identify presence and status of licenses required of the industry + jurisdiction. 
- Identify license link to officer / owner / person or business entity.�skill-1789767328449:Who ultimately owns this, who is authorized to sign, and does the attestation hold up?

Always:
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

When submitted:
- Verify business entities listed as owners / officers
- Verify people listed as owners / officers
- Verify registered agents listed as owners / officers�skill-financial-standing:Does the business carry debts, judgments or insolvency that bear on the account?

Always:
- Identify UCC and tax liens on the business, open and closed, with the secured party and what is secured
- Identify litigation naming the business, which side it is on, and any money judgment
- Identify bankruptcy filings by the business
- Read each against the business's age and line of work: equipment finance and an SBA loan are ordinary for a bakery; a state tax lien or an all-assets blanket filing is not

When submitted:
- Identify liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the submitted people

report.headline: Onboard subject to a beneficial ownership certification with KYC and screening on each owner and signer, a statement of the business's activity, and a Certificate of Good Standing.

body.text: KAIROS 801 LLC holds one active domestic New York filing under the submitted name (file 6552607, registered 1 August 2022), its only registration. The entity is an LLC, and the name suffix matches the filing.

The filing names LegalZoom USCA, Inc. for service of process and United States Corporation Agents, Inc. as registered agent, both in agent roles rather than as owners or officers. No website was found to carry the business name, and no TIN or phone was submitted, so no IRS name match was run.

gaps.point: Whether the LLC is in good standing: New York publishes an active status but no good-standing sub-status.

body.text: The watchlist screen returned no hits across all 14 lists screened, including OFAC SDN and the BIS Entity List. The adverse media screen returned no results.
The PEP screen returned no hits, but it covers submitted individuals and their relatives and close associates, and no individuals were submitted. No owner or signer has yet been screened by name.

gaps.point: Sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening of the owners and signers, once named.
Criminal history of the owners and signers; the check was not ordered.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a deposit account, and no individuals are yet named to run it against.

body.text: The line of work is not established. Industry classification returned insufficient data, no website or third-party profile was found, and the name gives no indication of the trade, so the industry screen had no activity to classify.

The submitted office address, 801 Madison Ave Fl 3, New York, matches the filing and is a deliverable commercial property. The filing also lists a residential apartment in Bayside and two Brooklyn registered-agent addresses, which is ordinary for an LLC that uses a registered agent.

gaps.point: What the business does, what the account will be used for, and whether that activity requires a licence.

body.text: No owners, officers or signers were submitted, and the New York filing names no members; a New York LLC filing does not publish them. The only party on it, LegalZoom USCA, Inc., is listed for service of process. No identity verification is held.

Two connections were found. KAIROS PHYSICAL THERAPY PLLC shares both non-agent filing addresses, the Bayside residence and 801 Madison Ave, and its name; J.L.W. INVESTORS, LTD. shares only 801 Madison Ave, a commercial address used by 21 businesses.

gaps.point: Who owns and controls the LLC, their percentages, and who is authorised to sign.
Identity verification of each owner and signer.
Whether KAIROS 801 LLC shares ownership with KAIROS PHYSICAL THERAPY PLLC.

body.text: The business has no UCC or tax liens, no bankruptcy filings and no related litigation on record, across roughly four years since formation.

gaps.point: Liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the owners, who are not yet identified.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a deposit account where the business-level record is clear.

followUps.text:
Collect a beneficial ownership certification naming each owner, their percentage, and each authorised signer.
No people were submitted, and the New York filing names only LegalZoom USCA, Inc., for service of process.

Run KYC and sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening on each owner and signer once named.
No identity verification is held, and the PEP screen covered no individuals because none were submitted.

Obtain a description of the business and its expected account activity, and confirm any licence that activity requires.
Industry classification returned insufficient data, and no website or third-party profile was found.

Establish whether KAIROS 801 LLC shares ownership with KAIROS PHYSICAL THERAPY PLLC.
The two share a name and both non-agent filing addresses, including the Bayside residence.

Submit an RFI for a Certificate of Good Standing.
New York publishes an active status but no good-standing sub-status.

j.l.w. investors, ltd..name: Bank account opening
j.l.w. investors, ltd..brief:
Run the four assessments attached to this assessment workflow. Make sure to keep the tone of the assessment in the mindset of a financial services compliance analyst that works at a bank like Mercury who is onboarding businesses to their bank. 

Make sure the prose is very concise and do not be overtly verbose. Only share what is relevant to the decision.

Write no recommendation prose at all. Do not summarise the assessments or repeat what they established; the reader has just read them. The recommendation section is the follow-ups and nothing else.

Each follow-up is one thing to do before the account opens, with only the facts that justify it behind it. Two lines, at most three: the instruction, then why. If nobody could act on it tomorrow, leave it out — a connected business that is plainly a neighbour is a fact for the assessment, not a step. Steps come from what the record leaves open and from what a registry does not publish: a missing good-standing sub-status is an RFI, not a shrug.�skill-kyb-identification:Is this a real, distinct, active entity, and is it the one on the application?

Always:
- Verify the submitted business name matches a state filing
- Verify the submitted address matches a state filing
- Identify Secretary of State filings (domestic and foreign)
- Identify Certificate of Good Standing or Secretary of State filings sub status is in good standing
- Identify unsubmitted entity classification type
- Identify unsubmitted industry classification 
- Identify unsubmitted web presence and third-party profiles
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers 
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

If submitted:
- Verify that the TIN belongs to a name associated with the business entity. If a TIN is not submitted do not elevate
- Verify DBA names, this is not a requirement, if the DBA is not submitted you literally dont have to mention it
- Verify entity classification type for the business entity
- Verify third-party profiles for the business entity
- Verify website presence for the business entity
- Verify email for the business entity
- Verify phone for the business entity�skill-kyb-3:Does the business, any UBO, or any signer trigger a sanctions or enforcement obligation?

Always:
- Flag hits for submitted business name Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted business name Adverse Media hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people PEP hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Adverse Media hits�skill-kyb-activity:Is the industry eligible under policy, and is the business licensed where it operates?

Always:
- Identify whether the industry is a high-risk or prohibited industry
- Identify whether there is evidence of other industry activity not detected that point to high-risk or prohibited industries
- Identify presence and status of licenses required of the industry + jurisdiction. 
- Identify license link to officer / owner / person or business entity.�skill-1789767328449:Who ultimately owns this, who is authorized to sign, and does the attestation hold up?

Always:
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

When submitted:
- Verify business entities listed as owners / officers
- Verify people listed as owners / officers
- Verify registered agents listed as owners / officers�skill-financial-standing:Does the business carry debts, judgments or insolvency that bear on the account?

Always:
- Identify UCC and tax liens on the business, open and closed, with the secured party and what is secured
- Identify litigation naming the business, which side it is on, and any money judgment
- Identify bankruptcy filings by the business
- Read each against the business's age and line of work: equipment finance and an SBA loan are ordinary for a bakery; a state tax lien or an all-assets blanket filing is not

When submitted:
- Identify liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the submitted people

report.headline: Do not onboard: the corporation's only registration is inactive and no owner, signer or line of business is on the record; reconsider on evidence of reinstatement, a complete ownership certification and a stated business activity.

body.text: J.L.W. INVESTORS, LTD. is a New York corporation formed on 17 August 1983 (file 862051), and the submitted name matches that domestic filing; the name's suffix is consistent with the registered entity type. The filing is inactive, and the business holds no active Secretary of State filing in any state.
The filing states no reason for the inactive status and lists no officers or registered agent. No TIN, phone number, website or third-party profile was submitted.

gaps.point: Why the corporation is inactive and whether it has been reinstated: New York publishes no sub-status or reason for the status.

body.text: The business name returned no hits on any watchlist screened, including OFAC's SDN and sectoral sanctions lists and the Commerce and State Department export and debarment lists. The adverse media screen returned no results for the business.
The PEP screen returned no hits, but no individuals were submitted or listed on the filing, so no owner, officer or signer has been screened for sanctions, PEP status or adverse media.

gaps.point: Sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening of the owners, officers and signers once identified.
Criminal history of the people behind the business.
gaps.noAction: Not ordered and not required to open a business deposit account; no individuals are on the record to search.

body.text: The business classifies as investment and credit services, with security brokerage (MCC 6211) and portfolio management and investment advice (NAICS 523940) as the nearest codes. No website or third-party profile was found, so nothing on the record describes what the business actually does.
The submitted office, 801 Madison Ave Fl 3, New York, matches the filing and is a deliverable commercial property, and the business is inactive in the state of that address.

gaps.point: What the business does and, if it advises on or deals in securities, whether it holds the required registration.
gaps.wouldAnswer: A customer statement of business activity and expected account use, and an SEC IAPD, FINRA BrokerCheck or New York registration lookup if the activity is securities-related.

body.text: No people were submitted, and the New York filing lists no officers, directors or registered agent, so no owner, controller or signer is on the record. New York does not publish a corporation's shareholders, and no KYC has been run.

Two businesses are connected only through the filing's address, 801 Madison Ave Fl 3, which 21 businesses use: KAIROS 801 LLC and KAIROS PHYSICAL THERAPY PLLC. Neither connection shares any people with the business.

gaps.point: Who beneficially owns the corporation, who controls it, and who is authorized to sign for it.
Identity verification of the beneficial owners and signers.

body.text: The business has no liens, bankruptcy filings or related litigation on record.

gaps.point: Liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the owners.
gaps.noAction: No owners are identified to search, and the business-level record is clear.

followUps.text:
Request evidence that the corporation has been reinstated, such as a current New York Certificate of Status.
Its only filing, from 1983, is inactive, and New York publishes no reason or sub-status.

Collect a beneficial ownership certification naming each 25% owner, the controlling officer and the authorized signers.
No people were submitted and the filing lists no officers.

Run KYC and sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening on each person certified.
The business-level screens are clear, but no individual has been verified or screened.

Obtain a description of the business and the account's expected use, and verify any securities or investment-adviser registration it requires.
It classifies as investment and credit services, and no website or profile shows what it does.

jayleaf, llc.name: Bank account opening
jayleaf, llc.brief:
Run the four assessments attached to this assessment workflow. Make sure to keep the tone of the assessment in the mindset of a financial services compliance analyst that works at a bank like Mercury who is onboarding businesses to their bank. 

Make sure the prose is very concise and do not be overtly verbose. Only share what is relevant to the decision.

Write no recommendation prose at all. Do not summarise the assessments or repeat what they established; the reader has just read them. The recommendation section is the follow-ups and nothing else.

Each follow-up is one thing to do before the account opens, with only the facts that justify it behind it. Two lines, at most three: the instruction, then why. If nobody could act on it tomorrow, leave it out — a connected business that is plainly a neighbour is a fact for the assessment, not a step. Steps come from what the record leaves open and from what a registry does not publish: a missing good-standing sub-status is an RFI, not a shrug.�skill-kyb-identification:Is this a real, distinct, active entity, and is it the one on the application?

Always:
- Verify the submitted business name matches a state filing
- Verify the submitted address matches a state filing
- Identify Secretary of State filings (domestic and foreign)
- Identify Certificate of Good Standing or Secretary of State filings sub status is in good standing
- Identify unsubmitted entity classification type
- Identify unsubmitted industry classification 
- Identify unsubmitted web presence and third-party profiles
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers 
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

If submitted:
- Verify that the TIN belongs to a name associated with the business entity. If a TIN is not submitted do not elevate
- Verify DBA names, this is not a requirement, if the DBA is not submitted you literally dont have to mention it
- Verify entity classification type for the business entity
- Verify third-party profiles for the business entity
- Verify website presence for the business entity
- Verify email for the business entity
- Verify phone for the business entity�skill-kyb-3:Does the business, any UBO, or any signer trigger a sanctions or enforcement obligation?

Always:
- Flag hits for submitted business name Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted business name Adverse Media hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people PEP hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Adverse Media hits�skill-kyb-activity:Is the industry eligible under policy, and is the business licensed where it operates?

Always:
- Identify whether the industry is a high-risk or prohibited industry
- Identify whether there is evidence of other industry activity not detected that point to high-risk or prohibited industries
- Identify presence and status of licenses required of the industry + jurisdiction. 
- Identify license link to officer / owner / person or business entity.�skill-1789767328449:Who ultimately owns this, who is authorized to sign, and does the attestation hold up?

Always:
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

When submitted:
- Verify business entities listed as owners / officers
- Verify people listed as owners / officers
- Verify registered agents listed as owners / officers�skill-financial-standing:Does the business carry debts, judgments or insolvency that bear on the account?

Always:
- Identify UCC and tax liens on the business, open and closed, with the secured party and what is secured
- Identify litigation naming the business, which side it is on, and any money judgment
- Identify bankruptcy filings by the business
- Read each against the business's age and line of work: equipment finance and an SBA loan are ordinary for a bakery; a state tax lien or an all-assets blanket filing is not

When submitted:
- Identify liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the submitted people

report.headline: Onboard subject to clearing the Foreign Terrorist Organizations and SDN name matches and the PEP hit on the submitted people, KYC on Jose Ornelas, and a beneficial ownership certification.

body.text: JAYLEAF, LLC is a California LLC formed on 4 September 2009 (file 200925110153). The record holds one filing, an active domestic registration under the submitted name, and California reports it in good standing.
An unsubmitted website, jayleaf.com, carries the legal name, and the record holds unsubmitted Instagram, Facebook and Google profiles for the business. No TIN, phone or email was submitted.

The watchlist screen returned three hits, all on the submitted people and none on the business name. Manuel Rodriguez, the registered agent, matches an exact-name entry, "Manuel Rodriguez", on the State Department's Foreign Terrorist Organizations list, and partially matches VALDEZ RODRIGUEZ, Manuel Arturo on OFAC's SDN list. Jose Ornelas, the manager, partially matches ORNELAS FERREIRA, Jose Adelino on the SDN list. No entry carries identifiers beyond the name.
The PEP screen returned a direct hit on Manuel Rodriguez, with no position, jurisdiction or source attached. Nothing was returned on Jose Ornelas.

Adverse media returned 26 articles matched to Manuel Rodriguez and nothing on the business or Jose Ornelas. The articles concern other people sharing the name or a variant of it: an Amber Alert for a 17-year-old in Baja California, Mexican and Venezuelan corruption reporting, Texas and California criminal appeals, and statue vandalism in San Francisco. None of the article titles refers to the business.

gaps.point: Whether the Foreign Terrorist Organizations entry and the two SDN entries are the submitted people or namesakes.
gaps.wouldAnswer: A disposition of each list entry against the individual's date of birth, address and nationality.

gaps.point: Whether the PEP hit and the adverse media articles concern this Manuel Rodriguez.
gaps.wouldAnswer: The PEP entry's position and jurisdiction, and a disposition of both against his identifiers.

gaps.point: Criminal history of the submitted people.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a deposit account; the sanctions, PEP and adverse media screens cover the individuals.

body.text: The business classifies as noncitrus fruit farming (NAICS 111339), with fresh fruit and vegetable wholesale as a secondary match, and in no prohibited or restricted industry category. The online website presents it as an organics grower and the Facebook and Google profiles categorise it as a farm; the equipment it finances, tractors, a vacuum cooler and a tray-sealing machine, fits growing and packing produce.

The submitted office address matches the filing, is a deliverable commercial property, appears on the website, and lies in California, where the business is active. The filing's commercial address is 1900 S Norfolk St, San Mateo, listed as the registered agent's and used by more than 100 businesses. The operating site is 3000 Cienega Rd, Hollister, the filing's primary address and the address on the business's EPA facility and FMCSA registrations; it is residential, as is ordinary for a farm.

gaps.point: Licences held by the business; no licence check is on the record.
gaps.wouldAnswer: A licence search against California and federal agricultural registries.
gaps.noAction: Crop farming is not a licensed activity for account-opening purposes, and the record already carries the business's USDOT registration (3309219).

body.text: Both submitted people are on the California filing: Jose Ornelas, submitted as chief executive officer and manager, is its only officer, and Manuel Rodriguez is its registered agent. No business entity or commercial agent holds either role. The filing names managers but no members or percentages; Jose M. Ornelas, Jose Miguel Ornelas and Margarita Ornelas appear with the business as co-debtors on its financing, which is consistent with family ownership but does not establish it.

Eight connections were found. G WELLNESS LLC and ENVYUS ENTERTAINMENTS LLC connect through Jose A Ornelas. The other six connect through Manuel P Rodriguez; of these, ORNELAS EQUIPMENT HOLDING, LLC also shares the business's primary address at 3000 Cienega Rd and its Hollister PO box, while two Rodriguez Bros. investment companies, BRSPCTFL, LLC, a collision centre and a smog garage share no address.

gaps.point: Who the members are, their percentages, and whether Manuel Rodriguez holds an interest.
Identity verification of Jose Ornelas and identifiers for Manuel Rodriguez.
Who is behind ORNELAS EQUIPMENT HOLDING, LLC and whether it shares ownership with the business.

body.text: All 28 lien filings are California UCC filings; there are no tax liens. Eleven are open. Seven secure specific equipment: tractors financed by Deere & Company and CNH Industrial Capital, a tray-sealing machine (Mitsubishi HC Capital, two filings), a WestRock CP machine and a Hanmi Bank equipment lease. Four are blanket filings over all or substantially all assets: the U.S. Small Business Administration (2020), American AgCredit FLCA (2021, including farm products and water rights), and two filed by representatives that do not name the lender, Financial Agent Services (2022) and CHTD Company (2023). The 17 closed filings, from 2014 to 2024, are equipment lessors and Bank of the West.

For a farm and packer formed in 2009, equipment finance, an agricultural lender's blanket lien and an SBA filing are ordinary. The two representative-filed blanket liens leave the lender and amount unstated.

Two motor-vehicle suits in California name the business as a defendant. One, filed in April 2025 in Los Angeles County Superior Court (25CMCV00542), is open, with no judgment recorded. The other, filed in 2018 in Santa Clara County Superior Court (18CV324420), closed after summary judgment for the business and its co-defendants in 2021. The business has no bankruptcy filings.

gaps.point: Which lenders stand behind the 2022 and 2023 blanket filings made through representatives.
gaps.noAction: The secured lender's identity does not bear on opening a deposit account.

gaps.point: The amount claimed in the open 2025 motor-vehicle suit.
gaps.noAction: An open vehicle claim against a farm running its own trucks is ordinary and carries no money judgment.

gaps.point: Liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming Jose Ornelas or Manuel Rodriguez.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a deposit account where the business-level record is complete.

followUps.text:
Run KYC on Jose Ornelas and collect date of birth and residential address for Manuel Rodriguez.
Both carry unresolved screening hits and no identity verification is held.

Disposition the three watchlist hits against those identifiers before the account opens.
Manuel Rodriguez matches a Foreign Terrorist Organizations entry exactly and an SDN entry in part, Jose Ornelas an SDN entry in part, and no entry carries identifiers.

Disposition the PEP hit and the 26 adverse media articles on Manuel Rodriguez.
The PEP hit carries no position or jurisdiction, and the articles concern namesakes in Mexico, Venezuela and US criminal appeals.

Collect a beneficial ownership certification naming each member and percentage, and stating whether Manuel Rodriguez holds an interest.
The California filing names Jose Ornelas as manager only, and two further Ornelas family members appear as co-debtors on the business's financing.

Establish who is behind ORNELAS EQUIPMENT HOLDING, LLC.
It shares the business's primary address and PO box and connects through Manuel P Rodriguez; a common owner is plausible but not on the record.

Run the four assessments attached to this assessment workflow. Make sure to keep the tone of the assessment in the mindset of a financial services compliance analyst that works at a bank like Mercury who is onboarding businesses to their bank. 

Make sure the prose is very concise and do not be overtly verbose. Only share what is relevant to the decision.

Write no recommendation prose at all. Do not summarise the assessments or repeat what they established; the reader has just read them. The recommendation section is the follow-ups and nothing else.

Each follow-up is one thing to do before the account opens, with only the facts that justify it behind it. Two lines, at most three: the instruction, then why. If nobody could act on it tomorrow, leave it out — a connected business that is plainly a neighbour is a fact for the assessment, not a step. Steps come from what the record leaves open and from what a registry does not publish: a missing good-standing sub-status is an RFI, not a shrug.�skill-kyb-identification:Is this a real, distinct, active entity, and is it the one on the application?

Always:
- Verify the submitted business name matches a state filing
- Verify the submitted address matches a state filing
- Identify Secretary of State filings (domestic and foreign)
- Identify Certificate of Good Standing or Secretary of State filings sub status is in good standing
- Identify unsubmitted entity classification type
- Identify unsubmitted industry classification 
- Identify unsubmitted web presence and third-party profiles
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers 
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

If submitted:
- Verify that the TIN belongs to a name associated with the business entity. If a TIN is not submitted do not elevate
- Verify DBA names, this is not a requirement, if the DBA is not submitted you literally dont have to mention it
- Verify entity classification type for the business entity
- Verify third-party profiles for the business entity
- Verify website presence for the business entity
- Verify email for the business entity
- Verify phone for the business entity�skill-kyb-3:Does the business, any UBO, or any signer trigger a sanctions or enforcement obligation?

Always:
- Flag hits for submitted business name Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted business name Adverse Media hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people PEP hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Adverse Media hits�skill-kyb-activity:Is the industry eligible under policy, and is the business licensed where it operates?

Always:
- Identify whether the industry is a high-risk or prohibited industry
- Identify whether there is evidence of other industry activity not detected that point to high-risk or prohibited industries
- Identify presence and status of licenses required of the industry + jurisdiction. 
- Identify license link to officer / owner / person or business entity.�skill-1789767328449:Who ultimately owns this, who is authorized to sign, and does the attestation hold up?

Always:
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

When submitted:
- Verify business entities listed as owners / officers
- Verify people listed as owners / officers
- Verify registered agents listed as owners / officers�skill-financial-standing:Does the business carry debts, judgments or insolvency that bear on the account?

Always:
- Identify UCC and tax liens on the business, open and closed, with the secured party and what is secured
- Identify litigation naming the business, which side it is on, and any money judgment
- Identify bankruptcy filings by the business
- Read each against the business's age and line of work: equipment finance and an SBA loan are ordinary for a bakery; a state tax lien or an all-assets blanket filing is not

When submitted:
- Identify liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the submitted people

report.headline: Onboard subject to a beneficial ownership certification, KYC on Meg Ray, and proof of the Larkspur address.

body.text: MIETTE CAKES, LLC is a California LLC formed 24 March 2003 (file 200308510012), and the submitted name matches the filing. It holds one registration, the California domestic filing, which is active and in good standing.
No website was submitted. One was found, miette.com, and it shows the submitted business name. No TIN, phone or email was submitted.
The watchlist screen returned no hits across the 14 OFAC, BIS and State Department lists checked.
The PEP screen returned no hits on Meg Ray or her relatives and close associates. The adverse media screen returned no results.

gaps.point: Criminal history on Meg Ray was not ordered.
gaps.noAction: Not a standard account-opening requirement; the watchlist, PEP and adverse media screens cover the obligation.

body.text: The business classifies as a retail bakery (NAICS 311811; MCC 5462 and 5441), not a high-risk or prohibited category. The website, Miette Patisserie & Confiserie, is online, and the four third-party profiles are online and describe the same trade: Google lists a bakery, BBB Foods, Facebook a candy store.

The submitted address, 2009 Larkspur Landing Cir, Larkspur, is not on the filing, which lists 2220 Mountain Blvd Ste 140 and a residence on Creed Rd, both in Oakland. The Larkspur address is a deliverable commercial property and the website shows it, which reads as a second shop rather than the registered one. The business is active in California, the state of the submitted address.
A retail food business needs a county health permit for each location, and no check on the record covers it. The record carries an active California sales tax permit at the Mountain Blvd address.

gaps.point: Whether the business holds a current food facility permit for the Oakland and Larkspur locations.
gaps.wouldAnswer: A search of Alameda and Marin County environmental health food facility permits for MIETTE CAKES, LLC at 2220 Mountain Blvd, Oakland and 2009 Larkspur Landing Cir, Larkspur.

body.text: The filing names the submitted person, Meg Ray (Megan Ray on the filing), as chief executive officer, manager and registered agent, and no other person, business entity or third-party agent. Control rests with one individual. The filing shows no members or ownership percentages.

Three connected businesses were found. MIETTE, LLC shares Megan Ray and 85 Webster St, Oakland, the address on the business's inactive sales tax permit. BATCH PASTRIES, LLC shares 2220 Mountain Blvd Ste 140, the business's filing and sales tax address. REEMS CA JLS COOPERATIVE INC. shares only 85 Webster St.

gaps.point: Who the members are and what each holds; the California filing names only the manager.
Meg Ray's identity has not been verified; KYC was not ordered.
Whether MIETTE, LLC and BATCH PASTRIES, LLC share ownership with the business.

body.text: Five UCC filings are open and no tax liens were found. Two, from June and October 2025, cover equipment under finance agreements, and a 2022 Mr. Espresso filing covers espresso and coffee equipment at the Mountain Blvd shop, which is ordinary for a bakery. A 2021 Fremont Bank filing publishes no collateral, and an April 2025 filing covers all assets, with the secured party shown only as C T Corporation System, as representative. Four earlier UCC filings, 2011 to 2019, are closed.
No bankruptcy filings or litigation name the business.

gaps.point: The lender behind the April 2025 all-assets filing, what the Fremont Bank filing secures, and the balances outstanding.
Liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming Meg Ray were not ordered.
gaps.noAction: The business-level searches cover the account; personal searches on the manager are not an account-opening requirement.

followUps.text:
Collect a beneficial ownership certification listing each member and their percentage.
The California filing names Megan Ray as manager only and shows no members.

Run KYC on Meg Ray.
She is the only person on the filing (CEO, manager and registered agent), and her identity has not been verified.

Obtain proof that the business operates at 2009 Larkspur Landing Cir, Larkspur, such as a lease or utility bill.
The filing lists only Oakland addresses; the website shows the Larkspur address.

Request a debt schedule for the five open UCC filings, naming the lender and balance behind the April 2025 all-assets filing.
Its secured party appears only as C T Corporation System, as representative.

Ask the applicant whether MIETTE, LLC and BATCH PASTRIES, LLC are affiliates under common ownership.
MIETTE, LLC shares Megan Ray; BATCH PASTRIES, LLC shares the Mountain Blvd suite.

Verify a current county food facility permit for the Oakland and Larkspur locations.
The business is a retail bakery, and no check on the record covers health permits.

recent_reviews.author: Vanessa Sladewski

recent_reviews.text: Such a beautiful place. tasty macaroon and a delightful ice cream sandwiches.  A great little shop for sweets and cakes.
recent_reviews.author: Emily Lincoln

recent_reviews.text:
Best ice cream sandwich ever!
Had the creme fraishe flavor :)
recent_reviews.author: Sylvia Longworth-Catt

recent_reviews.text: The macarons were delightful. Light, airy, and flavorful. The lemon tart was perfect. The crust was buttery and flakey. The filling was thick and full of lemon flavor. The brownie with walnut was exceptional. It was just the way I love my brownies: full of chocolate flavor but not over powering with sugar. The batter was very moist with a nice crust. The walnuts were and big and a nice flavor compliment to the cocoa. Great customer service. I was glad I ran to make it to your store before you closed for the night.
recent_reviews.author: Nicole Stewart

recent_reviews.text: So pretty. The customer service was excellent. The ice cream was other worldly.
recent_reviews.author: Amanda Rana

recent_reviews.text: We ordered a small lemon cake for our elopement dinner. Ordering ahead of time online was super simple, which I appreciated since we were out of state. I couldn't help but buy more goodies and sweets when we went into the shop to pick up the cake!  The cake was just lovely, macaroons were amazing, and we're still nibbling on the English toffee now that we're back home. Thank you, Miette, for making our elopement and trip a sweet one!
recent_reviews.author: Ashley Wood Schwenneker

miette patisserie & confiserie.name: Bank account opening
miette patisserie & confiserie.brief:
Run the four assessments attached to this assessment workflow. Make sure to keep the tone of the assessment in the mindset of a financial services compliance analyst that works at a bank like Mercury who is onboarding businesses to their bank. 

Make sure the prose is very concise and do not be overtly verbose. Only share what is relevant to the decision.

Write no recommendation prose at all. Do not summarise the assessments or repeat what they established; the reader has just read them. The recommendation section is the follow-ups and nothing else.

Each follow-up is one thing to do before the account opens, with only the facts that justify it behind it. Two lines, at most three: the instruction, then why. If nobody could act on it tomorrow, leave it out — a connected business that is plainly a neighbour is a fact for the assessment, not a step. Steps come from what the record leaves open and from what a registry does not publish: a missing good-standing sub-status is an RFI, not a shrug.�skill-kyb-identification:Is this a real, distinct, active entity, and is it the one on the application?

Always:
- Verify the submitted business name matches a state filing
- Verify the submitted address matches a state filing
- Identify Secretary of State filings (domestic and foreign)
- Identify Certificate of Good Standing or Secretary of State filings sub status is in good standing
- Identify unsubmitted entity classification type
- Identify unsubmitted industry classification 
- Identify unsubmitted web presence and third-party profiles
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers 
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

If submitted:
- Verify that the TIN belongs to a name associated with the business entity. If a TIN is not submitted do not elevate
- Verify DBA names, this is not a requirement, if the DBA is not submitted you literally dont have to mention it
- Verify entity classification type for the business entity
- Verify third-party profiles for the business entity
- Verify website presence for the business entity
- Verify email for the business entity
- Verify phone for the business entity�skill-kyb-3:Does the business, any UBO, or any signer trigger a sanctions or enforcement obligation?

Always:
- Flag hits for submitted business name Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted business name Adverse Media hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people PEP hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Adverse Media hits�skill-kyb-activity:Is the industry eligible under policy, and is the business licensed where it operates?

Always:
- Identify whether the industry is a high-risk or prohibited industry
- Identify whether there is evidence of other industry activity not detected that point to high-risk or prohibited industries
- Identify presence and status of licenses required of the industry + jurisdiction. 
- Identify license link to officer / owner / person or business entity.�skill-1789767328449:Who ultimately owns this, who is authorized to sign, and does the attestation hold up?

Always:
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

When submitted:
- Verify business entities listed as owners / officers
- Verify people listed as owners / officers
- Verify registered agents listed as owners / officers�skill-financial-standing:Does the business carry debts, judgments or insolvency that bear on the account?

Always:
- Identify UCC and tax liens on the business, open and closed, with the secured party and what is secured
- Identify litigation naming the business, which side it is on, and any money judgment
- Identify bankruptcy filings by the business
- Read each against the business's age and line of work: equipment finance and an SBA loan are ordinary for a bakery; a state tax lien or an all-assets blanket filing is not

When submitted:
- Identify liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the submitted people

report.headline: Onboard subject to evidence of the legal entity or owner behind MIETTE PATISSERIE & CONFISERIE, a beneficial ownership certification, and KYC on Meg Ray.

body.text: MIETTE PATISSERIE & CONFISERIE has no Secretary of State filing in any state, and the submitted name matches no state filing or DBA on file. With no formation record, the entity type, formation state and good-standing status are all unestablished. The name carries no corporate or LLC designator, which is consistent with an owner trading under a fictitious business name; California records those at county level, not with the Secretary of State.

An unsubmitted website, miette.com, shows the submitted business name. A 2020 California UCC filing also names the business as debtor under the same name, so the name has been used by a trading business for several years, though neither source identifies the legal person behind it.

gaps.point: Which legal entity or individual operates under the name, how it is formed, and whether it is in good standing.

body.text: The watchlist screen returned no hits across the OFAC, BIS and State Department lists screened, including the SDN list. The PEP screen found no hits on the submitted individual, Meg Ray, or her relatives and close associates.
The adverse media screen returned no results.

gaps.point: Criminal history on Meg Ray was not ordered.
gaps.noAction: Not a standard requirement for a deposit account for a food business with clear sanctions, PEP and adverse media screens.

body.text: The business classifies as a snack bar and retail bakery (NAICS 722515 and 311811), with bakery and confectionery merchant categories; the industry screen flags it in no restricted or prohibited category. The website was found rather than submitted and was online when ordered. No third-party profiles were found.

The submitted office address, 2252 Fillmore St, San Francisco, CA, is a deliverable commercial property, which suits a retail bakery. No source ties the business to it: there is no filing to match it against, the business is not registered in California, and the website neither shows the address nor names Meg Ray.

gaps.point: Whether the business operates at 2252 Fillmore St and holds the local business registration and food facility health permit that retail food sales in San Francisco require.
gaps.wouldAnswer: The San Francisco business registration certificate and Department of Public Health permit for the location, which name the operator and the address.

body.text: Meg Ray is the only person submitted, with no title, and is not matched to the business; with no state filing there is no officer or member list to match against. The entity type is unknown, so the ownership structure, and whether it is a sole proprietorship, partnership or registered entity, cannot be read from the record.
No connections to other businesses were found, and no business entities or registered agents appear as owners or officers.

gaps.point: Who owns the business, in what percentages, and Meg Ray's role and signing authority.
Identity verification of Meg Ray.

body.text: One open UCC lien, filed in California on 28 June 2020 and lapsing in June 2030, names the business as debtor and the U.S. Small Business Administration as secured party. The collateral is all tangible and intangible personal property, including inventory, equipment, accounts and deposit accounts. An SBA-secured loan is ordinary for a bakery; the filing states no amount.
The business has no related litigation and no bankruptcy filings.

gaps.point: The balance and repayment status of the SBA obligation the lien secures.
Liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming Meg Ray.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a deposit account where the business-level record carries no judgments or insolvency.

followUps.text:
Submit an RFI for the formation documents or county fictitious business name statement, the legal name of the operating entity or owner, and a Certificate of Good Standing if it is a registered entity.
The name matches no Secretary of State filing or DBA, so the entity type and standing are not on the record.

Collect a beneficial ownership certification naming each owner, their percentage and Meg Ray's role, and screen any owner not yet screened.
Meg Ray is the only person submitted and is not matched to any filing.

Run KYC on Meg Ray.
She is the only person submitted and no identity verification is held.

Collect the San Francisco business registration certificate and food facility health permit for 2252 Fillmore St.
No source ties the business to the submitted address, and no check on the record covers local permits.

Ask the customer to confirm the SBA loan secured by the 2020 UCC filing is current.
The filing is a blanket over all assets, including deposit accounts, and states no amount.

c & n trucking llc.name: Bank account opening
c & n trucking llc.brief:
Run the four assessments attached to this assessment workflow. Make sure to keep the tone of the assessment in the mindset of a financial services compliance analyst that works at a bank like Mercury who is onboarding businesses to their bank. 

Make sure the prose is very concise and do not be overtly verbose. Only share what is relevant to the decision.

Write no recommendation prose at all. Do not summarise the assessments or repeat what they established; the reader has just read them. The recommendation section is the follow-ups and nothing else.

Each follow-up is one thing to do before the account opens, with only the facts that justify it behind it. Two lines, at most three: the instruction, then why. If nobody could act on it tomorrow, leave it out — a connected business that is plainly a neighbour is a fact for the assessment, not a step. Steps come from what the record leaves open and from what a registry does not publish: a missing good-standing sub-status is an RFI, not a shrug.�skill-kyb-identification:Is this a real, distinct, active entity, and is it the one on the application?

Always:
- Verify the submitted business name matches a state filing
- Verify the submitted address matches a state filing
- Identify Secretary of State filings (domestic and foreign)
- Identify Certificate of Good Standing or Secretary of State filings sub status is in good standing
- Identify unsubmitted entity classification type
- Identify unsubmitted industry classification 
- Identify unsubmitted web presence and third-party profiles
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers 
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

If submitted:
- Verify that the TIN belongs to a name associated with the business entity. If a TIN is not submitted do not elevate
- Verify DBA names, this is not a requirement, if the DBA is not submitted you literally dont have to mention it
- Verify entity classification type for the business entity
- Verify third-party profiles for the business entity
- Verify website presence for the business entity
- Verify email for the business entity
- Verify phone for the business entity�skill-kyb-3:Does the business, any UBO, or any signer trigger a sanctions or enforcement obligation?

Always:
- Flag hits for submitted business name Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted business name Adverse Media hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people PEP hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Adverse Media hits�skill-kyb-activity:Is the industry eligible under policy, and is the business licensed where it operates?

Always:
- Identify whether the industry is a high-risk or prohibited industry
- Identify whether there is evidence of other industry activity not detected that point to high-risk or prohibited industries
- Identify presence and status of licenses required of the industry + jurisdiction. 
- Identify license link to officer / owner / person or business entity.�skill-1789767328449:Who ultimately owns this, who is authorized to sign, and does the attestation hold up?

Always:
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

When submitted:
- Verify business entities listed as owners / officers
- Verify people listed as owners / officers
- Verify registered agents listed as owners / officers�skill-financial-standing:Does the business carry debts, judgments or insolvency that bear on the account?

Always:
- Identify UCC and tax liens on the business, open and closed, with the secured party and what is secured
- Identify litigation naming the business, which side it is on, and any money judgment
- Identify bankruptcy filings by the business
- Read each against the business's age and line of work: equipment finance and an SBA loan are ordinary for a bakery; a state tax lien or an all-assets blanket filing is not

When submitted:
- Identify liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the submitted people

report.headline: Onboard subject to evidence that the Indiana administrative dissolution is cured and Tennessee authority reinstated, a beneficial ownership certification with KYC on Nathan Dean Ulery, and active FMCSA authority for USDOT 3614915.

body.text: C & N TRUCKING LLC matches the domestic Indiana filing for C & N TRUCKING, LLC (file 201803081244923, registered 8 March 2018), an LLC. The filing is active but carries a Pending Inactive sub-status with the detail Pending Admin Dissolution. It names Nathan Dean Ulery as CEO and Tidewater Incorporated as registered agent.

A Tennessee foreign filing (file 001186714, registered 15 May 2021) is inactive, revoked administratively. No website or third-party profile was found, so no web source corroborates the name. No TIN was submitted.

The watchlist screen returned one result on the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list: TRANSPORTADORA PUREPECHA S.A. DE C.V., alias PUREPECHA TRUCKING CO. It matches no name on the record; the only shared term is the word trucking.
The PEP screen returned no hits on submitted individuals or their relatives and close associates, but no individual was submitted with the application. The adverse media screen returned no results.

gaps.point: Sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening of Nathan Dean Ulery, the CEO named on the Indiana filing, who was not submitted.
Criminal history of the business's principals; the check was not ordered.
gaps.noAction: Not a standard requirement for a business deposit account, and no screen on the record indicates a need.

body.text: The business classifies as general freight trucking (NAICS 484110; MCC 4214), outside high-risk and prohibited categories. No website or third-party profile was found, so the classification is not corroborated by any web source. The record carries an FMCSA registration under USDOT 3614915.

The submitted office address, 516 Zachary St, Livingston, Tennessee, matches the filings and is a deliverable residential property, ordinary for a small carrier. The business is inactive in Tennessee, the state of that address: its foreign registration there was revoked administratively.

gaps.point: Whether USDOT 3614915 is active with current operating authority and insurance on file.
gaps.wouldAnswer: An FMCSA SAFER / Licensing and Insurance lookup of USDOT 3614915.

body.text: No people were submitted. The Indiana filing names one officer, Nathan Dean Ulery (CEO), who is also a named debtor on the business's UCC filings; the filing publishes no members or ownership percentages. The registered agent, Tidewater Incorporated, is a commercial agent, not an owner.
No business connections were found, and nothing on the record indicates an entity owner or a layered structure.

gaps.point: Who the LLC's members are, their percentages, and who controls and signs for it.
Identity verification of Nathan Dean Ulery.

body.text: One UCC filing is open: Indiana file 202109092825391, filed 9 September 2021 and lapsing in 2031, securing Corporation Service Company as representative against the business and Nathan Dean Ulery. The collateral is accounts purchased by the secured party plus all assets, including deposit accounts, with a covenant not to sell or encumber them elsewhere, which reads as a receivables purchase (factoring) arrangement. Two Tennessee filings are closed: a matching 2021 filing to the same secured party and a 2019 filing to Compass Equipment Finance LLC.

The ten related litigations were all filed between 2000 and 2003, at least 15 years before the 2018 Indiana formation, and carry a Schofield, Wisconsin address that appears nowhere else on the record. They comprise eight Wisconsin Department of Revenue delinquent withholding-tax warrants of about $1,600 to $2,000 each (seven unsatisfied), an unsatisfied $3,781.37 default judgment for Venture Insurance Company, and a closed State of Vermont case. There are no bankruptcy filings.

gaps.point: Whether the 2000 to 2003 Wisconsin and Vermont cases name this entity or an earlier business of the same name.
gaps.wouldAnswer: A reviewer disposition of each case against the entity's formation date, addresses and officer.

gaps.point: Liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming Nathan Dean Ulery.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a business deposit account once the business-level record has been read.

followUps.text:
Obtain evidence that the pending administrative dissolution in Indiana has been cured, such as a current Certificate of Existence.
The domestic filing is active but Pending Admin Dissolution.

Collect a beneficial ownership certification naming each member, their percentage and the control person, and confirming Nathan Dean Ulery's role.
No people were submitted, and the Indiana filing names one officer but no members.

Run KYC and sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening on Nathan Dean Ulery.
He is the only person on the record, and the PEP screen covered no one because no individual was submitted.

Require reinstatement of the Tennessee foreign registration, or an explanation of where the business operates.
The submitted office is in Livingston, Tennessee, where the registration was revoked administratively.

Confirm on FMCSA that USDOT 3614915 is active with current operating authority and insurance.
No check on the record covers carrier authority, and no website or profile corroborates the trucking activity.

Obtain the receivables purchase agreement behind the open UCC filing to Corporation Service Company.
Its all-assets collateral includes deposit accounts, so receivables may be directed to the secured party.

Record the OFAC SDN result, TRANSPORTADORA PUREPECHA S.A. DE C.V., as a false positive.
It matches no name on the record beyond the word trucking.

Disposition the ten 2000 to 2003 Wisconsin and Vermont cases as not naming this entity, or establish a link.
All predate the 2018 formation and carry a Wisconsin address found nowhere else on the record.

woo young lee dds inc.name: Bank account opening
woo young lee dds inc.brief:
Run the four assessments attached to this assessment workflow. Make sure to keep the tone of the assessment in the mindset of a financial services compliance analyst that works at a bank like Mercury who is onboarding businesses to their bank. 

Make sure the prose is very concise and do not be overtly verbose. Only share what is relevant to the decision.

Write no recommendation prose at all. Do not summarise the assessments or repeat what they established; the reader has just read them. The recommendation section is the follow-ups and nothing else.

Each follow-up is one thing to do before the account opens, with only the facts that justify it behind it. Two lines, at most three: the instruction, then why. If nobody could act on it tomorrow, leave it out — a connected business that is plainly a neighbour is a fact for the assessment, not a step. Steps come from what the record leaves open and from what a registry does not publish: a missing good-standing sub-status is an RFI, not a shrug.�skill-kyb-identification:Is this a real, distinct, active entity, and is it the one on the application?

Always:
- Verify the submitted business name matches a state filing
- Verify the submitted address matches a state filing
- Identify Secretary of State filings (domestic and foreign)
- Identify Certificate of Good Standing or Secretary of State filings sub status is in good standing
- Identify unsubmitted entity classification type
- Identify unsubmitted industry classification 
- Identify unsubmitted web presence and third-party profiles
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers 
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

If submitted:
- Verify that the TIN belongs to a name associated with the business entity. If a TIN is not submitted do not elevate
- Verify DBA names, this is not a requirement, if the DBA is not submitted you literally dont have to mention it
- Verify entity classification type for the business entity
- Verify third-party profiles for the business entity
- Verify website presence for the business entity
- Verify email for the business entity
- Verify phone for the business entity�skill-kyb-3:Does the business, any UBO, or any signer trigger a sanctions or enforcement obligation?

Always:
- Flag hits for submitted business name Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted business name Adverse Media hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Sanctions / Watchlist hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people PEP hits
- Flag hits for submitted / found people Adverse Media hits�skill-kyb-activity:Is the industry eligible under policy, and is the business licensed where it operates?

Always:
- Identify whether the industry is a high-risk or prohibited industry
- Identify whether there is evidence of other industry activity not detected that point to high-risk or prohibited industries
- Identify presence and status of licenses required of the industry + jurisdiction. 
- Identify license link to officer / owner / person or business entity.�skill-1789767328449:Who ultimately owns this, who is authorized to sign, and does the attestation hold up?

Always:
- Identify unsubmitted officers or people associated
- Identify unsubmitted business entities listed as owners / officers
- Identify unsubmitted registered agents listed as owners / officers
- Identify complexity of ownership structure for the business entity

When submitted:
- Verify business entities listed as owners / officers
- Verify people listed as owners / officers
- Verify registered agents listed as owners / officers�skill-financial-standing:Does the business carry debts, judgments or insolvency that bear on the account?

Always:
- Identify UCC and tax liens on the business, open and closed, with the secured party and what is secured
- Identify litigation naming the business, which side it is on, and any money judgment
- Identify bankruptcy filings by the business
- Read each against the business's age and line of work: equipment finance and an SBA loan are ordinary for a bakery; a state tax lien or an all-assets blanket filing is not

When submitted:
- Identify liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming the submitted people

report.headline: Onboard subject to a beneficial ownership certification evidencing each shareholder's dental licence, KYC on Woo Young Lee and a dental licence check.

body.text: WOO YOUNG LEE DDS INC matches a California domestic corporation, registered as WOO YOUNG LEE, D.D.S., INC. under file 2988384 on 10 May 2007. It is the business's only filing, and it is active and in good standing.
The corporation trades as Grace Dental Group, a DBA recorded to it in the San Francisco business registration. The website presents the practice under that name rather than the legal name.
The watchlist screen returned no hits across the 14 U.S. lists screened, including OFAC's SDN list. The PEP screen found no hits on Woo Young Lee or his relatives and close associates.
The adverse media screen returned no results.

gaps.point: Criminal history of Woo Young Lee; the check was not ordered.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a deposit account where sanctions, PEP and adverse media screens are clear.

body.text: The business classifies as an office of dentists (NAICS 621210, MCC 8021), which the industry screen places outside restricted and prohibited categories. Its website, gracedentalgroup.com, is online, presents a dental practice in San Francisco, shows the submitted office address and names Woo Young Lee.

The submitted office at 350 Divisadero St, San Francisco, matches the filing and is a deliverable commercial property, and the business is active in California. The city registration shows the practice moved there from 1426 Fillmore St in June 2024. No third-party profiles were found.

gaps.point: Whether Woo Young Lee and any other practising dentists hold current California dental licences; the D.D.S. designation makes this licensed activity, and no licence check is on the record.

body.text: Woo Young Lee, the submitted person, is matched to the filing as the corporation's sole officer (chief executive, chief financial officer, secretary and director) and its registered agent. A California corporation's filing names officers and directors, not shareholders.

The D.D.S. designation marks it as a dental corporation, whose shareholders California restricts to licensed dentists, so the beneficial ownership certification has to evidence each owner's licence as well as identity and percentage. A policy keyed on entity type reads it as a plain corporation and would not ask for that.

Nine connections were found. Bay Dental Group and 1062 SARATOGA LLC share Woo Young Lee as a person; H.K. LEE CORPORATION N.V. and VERONICA LEE DDS INC share the Hillsborough residential address on the filing. The other five share the current or former office address.

gaps.point: Who holds the corporation's shares and in what percentages.
Identity verification of Woo Young Lee.

body.text: Four UCC filings are open. Two are blanket liens from SBA lending: the U.S. Small Business Administration (June 2020, all assets including deposit accounts) and KeyPoint Credit Union under an SBA program (March 2022, inventory, equipment and receivables). The other two secure dental equipment, from U.S. Bank Equipment Finance (October 2022) and De Lage Landen (November 2024).

Both tax liens on the record are closed: a California Employment Development Department lien filed July 2010 and an IRS lien filed December 2010, each naming the corporation and Grace Dental Group. Six further UCC filings from 2009 to 2022 are closed. Equipment finance and SBA lending are ordinary for a dental practice of this age.
No bankruptcy filings or litigation name the business.

gaps.point: Liens, litigation and bankruptcies naming Woo Young Lee; the checks were not ordered.
gaps.noAction: Not required to open a deposit account where the business carries no open tax lien, bankruptcy or litigation.

followUps.text:
Collect a beneficial ownership certification naming each shareholder, their percentage and California dental licence number.
The filing publishes no shareholders, and a dental corporation's shareholders must be licensed dentists.

Run KYC on Woo Young Lee.
He is the only person submitted and the sole officer, and no identity verification is held.

Verify Woo Young Lee's licence on the Dental Board of California lookup.
The practice is licensed activity and no licence check is on the record.
